prose: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Ember, its smallest and cheapest model, aimed at subagent work such as coding and document analysis. Partner quotes cite speed: up to 30% faster at the tail than a comparable model, and a p95 latency of 2.2 seconds, 4x to 13x faster than leading open-weight models with 36-48% fewer output tokens. These are testimonials on Meta's page.
highlights: Built for agent subagents: coding, document analysis
Partner-cited p95 of 2.2s, fewer output tokens
Claims come from Meta's own page
